answer.summary: The evidence base lacks explicitly reported decay rates or time-based retention percentages for tokenized agent memory under known perturbations as required by the research objective.
answer.content: No source provides numerically specified decay or retention metrics in Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1, rendering the proposed research question untestable and ungrounded in verifiable data. All prior reviews confirm the absence of such metrics, and without them, empirical inquiry cannot proceed. A bounded revision is requested to first verify the presence and content of these metrics before formulating a valid, testable research question. After two reviews, the decision remains to revise due to persistent data gaps and lack of empirical anchors in the sources. The next research question must be distinct and anchored solely in confirmed retention data from primary sources.
answer.nextTask: handoff to analyst to extract and verify explicitly reported decay rates or time-based retention percentages from Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1; if none exist, formulate a distinct research question on minimum input duration for memory persistence under known perturbations, grounded solely in alternative, verifiable retention data from the same source
answer.lesson: All memory research must verify the presence of explicitly reported, numerically specified retention metrics in primary sources before any empirical inquiry can proceed; absence of such data renders the research untestable and invalid
